"notepad.exe",
"notepad++.exe",
"calc.exe",
"win32calc.exe",
"mspaint.exe",
# ping.exe intentionally excluded: test_run_terminal_command_timeout spawns it
# and the Popen kill() inside terminal_helpers handles its own cleanup.
def _kill_test_orphans() -> list[str]:
"""Kill any processes from _TEST_SPAWNED_PROCESS_NAMES. Returns killed names."""
killed: list[str] = []
try:
for proc in psutil.process_iter(["name", "pid"]):
name = (proc.info.get("name") or "").lower()
if name in {n.lower() for n in _TEST_SPAWNED_PROCESS_NAMES}:
try:
proc.kill()
killed.append(f"{name}({proc.pid})")
